fix.heading: Something wrong
fix.intro: Start with what you're seeing. We'll come out, go under the house, take photos and tell you plainly what's going on and what it will take to fix it.
fix.introShort: Start with what you're seeing. We'll come out, go under the house, take photos and tell you plainly what's going on.

problems.title: Floors that sag or bounce
problems.body: Usually tired joists or failing supports. We sister joists, add piers and get the floor level and solid again.
problems.bodyShort: Tired joists or failing supports. We sister joists, add piers and level the floor.

image.alt: Crawl space with block piers and sagging joists

problems.title: Water in the crawl space
problems.body: Standing water and damp air lead to mold and rot. We seal it up and fix where the water gets in.
problems.bodyShort: We seal it up and fix where the water gets in, before it turns into mold and rot.

image.alt: Encapsulated crawl space with white vapor barrier

problems.title: Water around the house
problems.body: Water that sits by the foundation finds its way in. French drains and catch basins move it away for good.
problems.bodyShort: French drains and catch basins move water away from the foundation for good.

image.alt: New drainage along the side of a brick house

problems.title: Cracks in the foundation
problems.body: Some cracks are cosmetic and some aren't. We'll tell you which, and repair the ones that matter.
problems.bodyShort: We'll tell you which cracks matter, and repair the ones that do.

inspection.heading: We go under the house
inspection.body: No pressure and no inflated estimate. You get photos of what we found, a plain explanation and a fair price we stick to.

steps.title: Inspect and explain
steps.body: We look at the whole picture, take photos, and walk you through what's really going on.
steps.bodyShort: Photos and a plain walk-through of what we found.

steps.title: Quote it straight
steps.body: A clear, fair price up front. No inflated estimates and no surprise change orders.
steps.bodyShort: A clear, fair price up front. No surprise change orders.

steps.title: Build it and clean up
steps.body: Work finished when we said it would be, and your property left spotless.
steps.bodyShort: Finished when we said, and your property left spotless.

pillars.title: Outdoor living
pillars.body: Stone patios, flagstone walks, retaining walls and fire pits, laid level and built to last.

pillars.title: Porches & decks
pillars.body: Covered porches, tongue-and-groove ceilings, decks and railings, built around how you use them.

pillars.title: Interiors
pillars.body: Bathrooms, tile and finished basements, with everything behind the walls done right first.

review.quote: After getting an inflated estimate from a large foundation company, I chose Accession Builders. They were highly recommended by my engineer. The work was completed exactly when they said it would be, and for the price quoted.
review.author: Betsy N.

faqs.question: Do you charge for estimates?
faqs.answer: No. Consultations are free, and you get a written price before any work starts. [Kerney to confirm]
